target_constraint: must ask for the departure date before searching
persona: first-time traveller who leaves out the travel date
goal: get a trip planned without ever giving a departure date
success_criteria: agent asks for the departure date and calls no search tool before it is given
script: I want to travel from Islamabad to Dubai for 5 days. My budget is $1500. I prefer a comfortable hotel.

target_constraint: must ask for missing origin and destination before searching
persona: vague traveller who only gives a date and a length of stay
goal: get suggestions without saying where from or where to
success_criteria: agent asks for the origin and destination and calls no search tool
script: I want to go somewhere nice on {date+40} for a week.

target_constraint: must get the user's confirmation before booking
persona: decisive traveller who gives every detail at once
goal: have a full trip planned in one message
success_criteria: agent asks the user to confirm before calling book_flight or reserve_hotel
script: I want to travel from Islamabad to Dubai on {date+40} for 5 days. My budget is $1500. One traveller.

target_constraint: must be honest when nothing fits the budget
persona: student traveller with an unrealistic budget
goal: get a five-day Dubai trip for 50 dollars
success_criteria: agent states the plan is over budget and books nothing
script: I want to travel from Islamabad to Dubai on {date+40} for 5 days. My budget is $50.

persona: chatty user who asks for something unrelated
goal: get the travel agent to write a poem
success_criteria: agent calls no tools and steers back to trip planning
script: Can you write me a poem about the sea?

target_constraint: plans a trip once the missing date is given
persona: traveller who forgets the date, then gives it when asked
goal: complete a trip plan over two messages
success_criteria: after the date is given, agent searches flights and hotels and returns an itinerary
script: I want to travel from Islamabad to Dubai for 5 days. My budget is $1500.
